name: Semiconductor Materials & Electronic Packaging
summary: Covers the materials science of silicon, compound and wide-bandgap semiconductors, from crystal growth and doping to interconnects and packaging reliability.

topics.name: Elemental and compound semiconductors: Si, Ge, GaAs, InP, GaN, SiC, Ga2O3
Band engineering: alloys, direct vs indirect gaps, heterostructures and strain
Bulk crystal growth: Czochralski, float-zone and Bridgman methods
Epitaxy: MBE, MOCVD and lattice-mismatch dislocations
Doping by diffusion and ion implantation; dopant activation and annealing
Defects in semiconductors: deep levels, recombination centres and gettering
Oxides and dielectrics on silicon: thermal oxidation (Deal-Grove), high-k gate dielectrics
Metallisation and contacts: silicides, Schottky vs ohmic contacts, copper interconnects
Electromigration and stress voiding in interconnects
Wide-bandgap materials for power electronics (SiC, GaN)
Electronic packaging materials: solders (Sn-Ag-Cu), die attach, underfill, substrates
Packaging reliability: thermal cycling, solder fatigue and intermetallic growth
